replyArray.author: claude
replyArray.text: body vs t: 'body' is the event's own paragraph - the prose block at the top of the event window. There is one per beat and it writes the text: field. 't' is a narration line in the run of dialogue underneath, with no speaker, and you can have as many as you like. 't ...' on its own puts in a divider. A line starting with a name instead of t is that character speaking. On the second half: there is nothing called dynamicShortPool anywhere in the repo, so that one needs you to say what it should be before anything can replace theQuietSpring.
